title: Have you guys been to the log cabin hotel?
content: Hey guys, just found out about this Reddit and thought it was pretty cool because I have a very similar experience but with a different location. For years now my brain has been mapping out this log cabin themed giant hotel. I know the entire layout and could draw it out (not the best artist so I haven’t) and while the hotel and its rooms and hallways and stuff don’t really make too much sense to have built in real life, they are all very real in my dreams and I have stories and memories about many rooms and could spend hours listing off details and things about this hotel. The hotel is a square main lobby, About 100-150 feet diameter and a giant carpet flooring about 75% of the time and then a marble tile floor/walkway surrounding it leading to log stairs up to wood log cabin style hallways surrounding the main floor, The hotel is probably 10 stories tall. The craziest part of the story though is when I went to Disneyland a few months ago, I visited the grand Californian and was shocked to find a pretty close example of my brains hotel, though rectangle instead of square and much less going on and much smaller, still very cool to see! Anyways please let me know if you’ve ever been to some place like this in a dream, I may map it out on paper some day, it’s truly a beautiful place lol Edit: I forgot to mention I have many other places like this, but I’ve sadly forgotten them. I remember telling my mom about a few places I’ve gone back to in dreams but since they were just small quirks I forgot them. I remember them or go back to them every once in a while and now I look forward to seeing them. None were as detailed and link so many dreams together as the log cabin hotel though, that place is very realistic lol
